_comment: Per-page-type ceilings on trust-concept mentions inside <main>. PROPOSALS from the 2026-09-09 spec until Sprint 0 calibrates them against the pages Perplexity/AIO actually cited (record the calibration date in `calibrated`). A term absent from a page type's map has no ceiling. `scam_owner` / `legit_owner` are the only slugs allowed to exceed the scam/legit ceilings.

title_max_chars_by_slug._comment: Per-slug override of title_max_chars. `index` carries the deliberate five-part Rule-21 title (breeder, 2026-09-10); 205 is the sitewide title ceiling (feedback_meta_format).

budgets_by_slug._comment: Per-slug override of budgets[page_type]. A number replaces the page-type ceiling; null removes the ceiling for that slug. `index`: the breeder restored the credential entities on the homepage on 2026-09-10 ("these are entities Google needs to see").
